description.zh-CN: 让无人机以固定半径和高度匀速环绕主体，利用地平线旋转和视差建立空间感。
description.en-US: Orbit a subject at constant radius, height, and speed to create continuous horizon rotation and parallax.

zh-CN.prompt: 无人机围绕[主体]进行平滑、匀速的圆周飞行：环绕半径为[8]米，高度为[4]米，向画面[右侧]移动，从上方俯视为顺时针方向，整个镜头覆盖约[200]度的弧线。地平线在主体身后持续旋转；不得改变高度、漂移环绕半径、变焦或使用速度渐变。

en-US.prompt: A smooth constant-speed circular drone flight around the [subject] — [8]-meter radius, [4]-meter altitude, traveling screen-[right] (clockwise seen from above), covering roughly a [200]-degree arc across the shot. The horizon rotates continuously behind the subject; no altitude change, no radius drift, no zoom, no speed ramps.
